julia_customer: Hey team — FinBank's security reviewer has a few follow-ups on the SIG/CAIQ and a bespoke section. They asked for: KMS/HSM key rotation policy + signed evidence, audit log export (retention proof), and confirmation about an observed 401 during a rotation window. Due next Tue EOD. Can we confirm what we can provide and a delivery ETA? :alarm_clock:

elaine_cs: Got it — thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact questionnaire lines they want filled and the timestamp of the 401?

julia_customer: Sure — they pointed to control A.5 (key lifecycle) and A.12 (audit logging). 401 occurred around 2026-03-10T03:14:12Z per their app logs. They included this snippet: 

```
2026-03-10T03:14:12Z ERROR request=generate status=401 request_id=abc123 client_id=finbank-prod
2026-03-10T03:14:13Z INFO kms rotate started key_id=key-2026-03-10
```

omar_se: Thanks — quick summary from infra: FinBank is on Redwood Private with customer-managed CMK (KMS backed by HSM). Default rotation policy is 90d, autoscheduled. We saw a key rotation job at 03:14 that started rotation for key-2026-03-10. There was a short period where the Dedicated routing cache still referenced the old key material and caused auth failures for tokens signed with the new key until cache invalidation completed (~45s). Root cause = propagation + cache TTL interplay, not a KMS failure.

mike_support: Repro steps we used: 
1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private-api.redwood.local/v1/generate  
2) rotate key via KMS console (or sim via kms-cli rotate key-2026-03-10) 
3) observe 401s in client for ~30-60s then normal resume. Example client output: "HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized"

omar_se: We mitigated in-prod by switching the worker pool to fallback key (key-prev-202602) and forcing an immediate cache invalidation. That stopped new 401s within ~1 minute. We'll include the mitigation timeline in the evidence.

sre-bot: Export request queued — audit export id audit-export-20260310-001. ETA ~ 20m. Contents: API auth events, kms.rotate events, cache.invalidate events for the window 2026-03-10T03:00:00Z..2026-03-10T04:00:00Z.

elaine_cs: For the SIG/CAIQ answer set we should provide: (1) rotation policy doc (signed by infra) describing schedule and customer-managed options, (2) HSM attestation link / vendor cert (redacted as needed), (3) CSV audit export for the incident window, (4) short timeline + root-cause blurb, (5) suggested process change (lower cache TTL during rotations + automated immediate cache invalidation hook). I'll compile.

omar_se: I'll prepare the KMS metadata snapshot (key ids, creation_date, rotation_schedule, rotation_type=auto) and a short explanation about CMK vs platform-managed keys. Also adding the exact command logs we used: 

```
kms-cli get-key key-2026-03-10 --format json
# returns: {"key_id":"key-2026-03-10","created":"2025-12-10T12:02:00Z","rotation":"90d","managed_by":"customer"}
```

mike_support: Audit CSV sample (will attach full export): 
"timestamp","event","user","resource","detail"
"2026-03-10T03:14:12Z","auth_failure","finbank-app","/v1/generate","status=401 request_id=abc123 key=key-2026-03-10"
"2026-03-10T03:14:13Z","kms.rotate.start","infra-service","key-2026-03-10","initiated_by=auto-schedule"
"2026-03-10T03:14:55Z","cache.invalidate","controller","routing-cache","keys_invalidated=[key-2026-03-10]"

elaine_cs: Proposed delivery plan: compile all artifacts + one-page exec summary and send to FinBank by Mon COB. If they insist on earlier, we can aim for Mon AM but need the audit export to be generated (sre-bot).

julia_customer: Mon COB is fine. Can you include a short signed statement confirming we saw only a brief propagation window and that keys/HSM were not compromised? They want language for their compliance team.

omar_se: We'll draft: "Redwood confirms that a scheduled rotation occurred and that HSM-backed key material was rotated as expected. A transient propagation delay caused <60s auth failures. No key compromise observed."

mike_support: FYI billing note — this incident did not trigger overage or billing charges; no invoices affected. Adding to the evidence bundle for completeness.

elaine_cs: Assigning tasks: omar_se -> KMS metadata + draft sentence; mike_support -> audit export + CSV; elaine_cs -> compile CAIQ answers, exec summary, package + signoff from infra. I'll post the final bundle in this thread when ready.

julia_customer: Perfect — thanks all. Please @me when the bundle is uploaded. :thumbsup:

mike_support: audit export uploaded: https://internal.s3.redwood/audit-exports/audit-export-20260310-001.csv (internal link) — attaching hash: sha256:3a7f...

elaine_cs: Draft CAIQ responses attached: https://internal.docs/redwood/caiaq/finbank-answers-draft-202603 (private). Will finalize after omar/mike confirm attachments. ETA Mon 17:00 UTC.

omar_se: Confirmed attachments and wording. Adding a small postmortem note we will share: change cache TTL from 5m -> 30s during planned rotation windows and add immediate cache invalidation hook. I'll open a follow-up internal RFC.

julia_customer: Thanks — acknowledged. We'll review and revert if they need edits.

elaine_cs: Bundle uploaded and signed. Delivered to FinBank security: delivery email sent 2026-03-15T16:45Z. Closing thread after any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
